# Protocol v1

Two links, both JSON-RPC 2.0. The desktop app talks to its local node over stdio (one JSON object per line). The node keeps one authenticated WebSocket to the gateway.

Every method declares who may call it, whether it names a scope the caller must hold, the lowest plan that may call it, and whether it writes. Writes carry an idempotency key; a replay returns the first result. The gateway rejects before the handler runs, and row-level security checks again in the database. Plan tiers are placeholders until pricing is set.

## App to node

| Method | Who can call | Scope | Lowest plan | Writes | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `node.info` | no sign-in | - | Starter | no | Node name, version, protocol version and platform |
| `session.state` | no sign-in | - | Starter | no | Whether a member is signed in on this device |
| `remote.call` | any member | - | Starter | no | Forward one gateway method (params: method, params, idempotency_key); the node holds the session, so the app never sees a token or the network |
| `local.ask` | any member | - | Starter | no | Answer from the replica, offline-capable, with citations |
| `local.context` | any member | - | Starter | no | Cited slices from the replica for a run started by this member |
| `local.sync_status` | any member | - | Starter | no | Per-scope sequence, root check and lag |
| `local.runs` | any member | - | Starter | no | Runs executing in this node, with steps and budgets |
| `local.permissions.decide` | any member | - | Starter | yes | Allow once, allow by rule, or deny a coding agent's permission request |
| `local.permissions.rules.list` | any member | - | Starter | no | Standing permission rules per project |
| `local.permissions.rules.set` | any member | - | Starter | yes | Create or change a standing permission rule |
| `local.permissions.rules.revoke` | any member | - | Starter | yes | Remove a standing permission rule |

## Pushed notifications

| Notification | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `sync.delta` | A numbered delta for a scope |
| `scope.revoked` | The member lost a scope; delete its partition |
| `key.rotated` | A scope key rotated |
| `task.updated` | A task changed state |
| `signoff.requested` | A department sign-off is waiting |
| `approval.requested` | A gated action is waiting for approval |
| `run.updated` | A run changed state |
| `lease.changed` | An artifact lease changed hands |
| `brief.ready` | A brief was refreshed |
| `proposal.created` | An ambient proposal was created |
| `tool.changed` | A tool definition changed and is blocked |
| `connection.expired` | A plugin connection needs sign-in again |
| `relay.offer` | A relay job this device may claim |
| `permission.requested` | A coding agent asks for a permission (app link) |

## Errors

Every error is `{ code, message, retryable }` inside the JSON-RPC error's `data`. Codes: `unauthenticated`, `token_expired`, `permission_denied`, `scope_denied`, `plan_required`, `rate_limited`, `payload_too_large`, `invalid_params`, `not_found`, `conflict`, `version_mismatch`, `approval_required`, `unavailable`, `internal`. Messages are safe to show a member and never contain SQL, paths or stack traces.

## Not yet defined

`jobs.claim` and `jobs.complete` (volunteer compute, after v0).
